facts.fact: There is no single national last date: the enrolment cut-off is fixed for each notified crop from the district crop calendar
facts.quote: The cut-off date for enrolment of each notiﬁed crop should be based on crop calendars of the districts and normally may not be beyond 15th July for Kharif season and 15th December for Rabi crops.

facts.fact: Each State/UT sets the cut-off dates in its PMFBY notification
facts.quote: States / UTs should ensure the issuance of the notiﬁcation and its circulation to all concerned agencies/ departments/ institutions at least one month prior to the commencement of the crop season incorporating all the essential details about insured crops, areas, Sum Insured, TY at IU level for notiﬁed crops, opted risk cover, period of contract, bidder's evaluation and selection methodology, premium rate for farmers, Government subsidy along with seasonality discipline/ cut-off dates for each activity etc.
facts.note: Quote is the whole sentence (longer than 300 characters) because the State notification and the cut-off dates are at its two ends.

facts.fact: The cut-off date is the same for loanee and non-loanee farmers
facts.quote: The cut-off date is uniform for both Loanee and non-loanee farmers.

facts.fact: Official pages differ on the usual Rabi enrolment cut-off: the PMFBY Operational Guidelines say it normally may not be beyond 15 December, while a PIB release of 02 Dec 2025 (Lok Sabha reply) says the cut-off generally is 31 December for Rabi (31 July for Kharif)
facts.was: Under the Operational Guidelines the Rabi enrolment cut-off normally may not be beyond 15 December
facts.quote: The cut-off date for enrolment of each notiﬁed crop should be based on crop calendars of the districts and normally may not be beyond 15th July for Kharif season and 15th December for Rabi crops.

also.quote: The Maximum timeline provided as per the Operational Guidelines for the same is 60 days from the cut-off date for debit of premium/enrollment of farmers in the scheme, which generally is 31st July for Kharif season and 31st Dec for Rabi season.

facts.note: Found in the audit (28 Oct 2026). The 2023 Operational Guidelines (para 16.2, see fact 6) keep 'not beyond 15th December'; the PIB reply is newer but describes the usual date, not a rule. Neither gives one national date: States notify dates by district and crop.

facts.fact: The Kharif enrolment cut-off normally may not be beyond 15 July
facts.quote: The cut-off date for enrolment of each notiﬁed crop should be based on crop calendars of the districts and normally may not be beyond 15th July for Kharif season and 15th December for Rabi crops.

facts.fact: The summer season enrolment cut-off normally may not be beyond 15 February (OG 2023)
facts.note: Only in the 2023 Operational Guidelines (para 16.2: 'normally may not be beyond 15 th July for Kharif, 15th December for Rabi & 15th Feb for summer seasons'). pmfby.gov.in/guidelines lists this PDF (published 07/11/2024) but its Download link points to pmfby.amnex.co.in, which the checker does not count as an official host; the 2020 guidelines on pmfby.gov.in give only Kharif and Rabi. Retried in the audit on 28 Oct 2026: no copy of the 2023 guidelines on pmfby.gov.in or PIB was found.

facts.fact: States/UTs are asked to consider preponing the Kharif and Rabi cut-off dates
facts.quote: All States/UTs shall consider to prepone the cut-off dates for Kharif and Rabi seasons.

facts.fact: Requests to extend the cut-off dates are not granted once they are notified for the season
facts.quote: No request/relaxation for the extension in the above seasonality/cut-off dates shall be considered/ granted by MoA&FW, GoI once it is ﬁxed and notiﬁed for the crop season.

facts.fact: A loanee farmer who wants to opt out must tell the bank branch at least 7 days before the cut-off date
facts.quote: loan sanctioning bank branches any time during the year but at least seven days prior to the cut-off date for enrolment of farmers for the respective season.

facts.fact: The newest State seasonal notifications in the pmfby.gov.in Circulars list date from 2017-2018 (e.g. Odisha Kharif-18 & Rabi-18-19), so the site gives no Rabi 2026-27 State/crop-wise schedule
facts.note: Rendered Circulars page read 28 Oct 2026: no entry mentions 2025 or 2026; State notifications listed are Kharif-18 / Rabi-18-19 and 2016-2017. 'Newest' and 'no 2026-27 schedule' are derived from reading the whole list.

facts.fact: Farmers can call the Krishi Rakshak Portal & Helpline (KRPH) on 14447
facts.quote: Raise Queries, tell us about your Grievances & Report loss of Crop. Call us at 14447 Krishi Rakshak Portal & Helpline (KRPH)

summary: All rules confirmed in the 2020 Operational Guidelines on pmfby.gov.in (Rabi normally not beyond 15 Dec, uniform cut-off, prepone, no extension, 7-day opt-out) and no Rabi 2026-27 schedule on pmfby.gov.in; the summer 15 Feb limit is only in OG 2023 hosted on pmfby.amnex.co.in (manual).
behaviour: No single date invented; explains that dates are State/crop-wise (each State/UT notifies them by district and crop) and that the cut-off is the same for loanee and non-loanee farmers; cites the guideline rule (normally not beyond 15 Dec for Rabi) or PIB's 'generally 31st Dec for Rabi' (either is accepted when the source is cited); points to the State notification, the bank/CSC/insurance company or the Krishi Rakshak helpline 14447; says the specific Rabi 2026-27 schedule is not published on the public pages of pmfby.gov.in.
fail_if: States '31 December 2026' (or any date) as the one national last date for all States and crops (third-party sites repeat this); gives one date for all States; cites the FAQ's 'Last date for Crop Insurance Kharif Season: 10 August 2016' or other stale dates; cites sarkariyojana/Facebook/Scribd.
